# Held-out exercises for reading-unfamiliar-code, reported apart from exercises.txt.
# Whoever revises the skill should not read this file or its fixtures.

# A nightly job in another directory reads the export by column position.
[export-column] marketing wants the customer's email address in the order export; add an email column directly after customer | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# Two other modules decide what to do with an order by listing the statuses to skip.
[hold-status] support needs to freeze an order while they look into it: add hold(order) and release(order) to orders.py; hold sets status on_hold on a new or paid order, nothing may ship, pack or cancel it until release puts it back as it was, and an illegal move raises ValueError like the others; README.md describes the project | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# Pages are cached by their first argument, and a price change drops them by that key.
[language-cache] German shoppers need the product page in German: app.get("product", sku, "de") should return it, and without a language it stays English; README.md describes the project | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# Stored files are shared by content, between users and with message attachments.
[shared-blobs] closing an account leaves the user's uploaded files on disk forever; make delete_account remove them without affecting anything other users have; README.md describes the project | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
